Package com.jpexs.decompiler.flash.abc.avm2.parser.script

Class AbcIndexing

java.lang.Object
com.jpexs.decompiler.flash.abc.avm2.parser.script.AbcIndexing
public final class AbcIndexing extends Object
Indexing of ABCs for faster access. Indexes ABC classes for faster class and property resolving.
